title: The Branco Weiss Fellowship

compensation.value: Up to CHF 600,000 for up to five years

about: Postdoctoral fellowship open to researchers in all disciplines, providing up to CHF 600,000 for up to five years. Applicants submit a motivation letter, research proposal, CV, host invitation letter and three best publications. Interviews take place in Zurich in June 2027.
requirements: PhD obtained no more than five years before 15 January 2027
Current or former faculty members (assistant professors or lecturers) are not eligible
card_alt: Card for The Branco Weiss Fellowship, a postdoctoral fellowship from The Branco Weiss Fellowship in Switzerland, with an application deadline of 15 Jan 2027. The photo shows the village of Zermatt with chalets at dusk, the snow-capped Matterhorn behind it and a Swiss flag in the foreground.
